# CONTAINER_HOST

A docker engine the lab places clusters and host services on, as `cata` reaches it.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Written `sigs.CONTAINER_HOST`.

Canonically `host`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.host`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
